title: PS/2 Protocol Signal Understanding

physical_lines.name: ps2_clk
physical_lines.description: Clock line driven by the keyboard or mouse

physical_lines.name: ps2_data
physical_lines.description: Serial data line, one bit per clock cycle

rtl_signals.name: rx_valid
rtl_signals.description: High for one cycle when byte is ready

learning_notes: PS/2 is very different from ALU — it is time-based and stateful
Data arrives one bit per clock falling edge
LSB is sent first (opposite of what I expected)
Need 11 clock pulses for one complete byte
FSM is the right way to model this behaviour
